subject: DI05019011

body.en:
Definition / principle

Additive manufacturing builds a part from digital geometry by adding material, usually layer by layer, unlike removing stock in conventional machining.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Process families: material extrusion, vat photopolymerisation, powder-bed fusion, material jetting, binder jetting, directed energy deposition, sheet lamination.
  • Syllabus mapping: FDM→material extrusion; SLA→vat photopolymerisation; laser sintering/fusion→powder-bed family; WAAM→wire/arc directed energy deposition.
  • Benefits: complex geometry, customisation and fewer dedicated tools; limits: surface/anisotropy, supports, post-processing, qualification, build time and material cost.
  • AM is not automatically cheaper, stronger, zero-waste or suitable for every safety-critical part.
Can every AM material run in the same printer?

No. Match feedstock form, material chemistry, process, thermal history and required final properties.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

AM digital geometryથી material ઉમેરતાં,સામાન્ય layer-by-layer part બનાવે; machiningમાં stock દૂર થાય.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Families material extrusion, vat photopolymerisation, powder-bed fusion, material jetting, binder jetting, directed energy deposition, sheet lamination.
  • Syllabus mapping FDM→extrusion; SLA→vat; laser sintering/fusion→powder-bed; WAAM→wire/arc DED.
  • Benefits complex geometry, customisation, dedicated tools ઓછાં; limits surface/anisotropy, supports, post-processing, qualification, time, cost.
  • AM હંમેશાં cheaper, stronger, zero-waste/દરેક safety-critical part માટે suitable નહિ.
દરેક AM Material એક જ Printerમાં ચાલે?

ના.Feed form, chemistry, process, thermal history અને required properties match કરવા જરૂરી છે.

h.en: 5.2.1 AM process chain: from need to inspection

body.en:
Definition / principle

The manufacturing chain includes preparation and verification, not only printer motion.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Application/requirements→CAD or validated scan reconstruction→design-for-AM and material/process choice.
  • Export suitable geometry, repair/check units, watertightness and features; choose orientation/supports and slice into layers.
  • Generate and review machine-compatible build instructions; operate only approved equipment procedures.
  • Remove/clean/support-release and complete required cure, heat treatment, machining or other post-processing.
  • Inspect dimensions, surface, internal integrity/material performance as required; update design/parameters from evidence.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Chainમાં preparation, verification પણ,ફક્ત printer motion નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Requirements→CAD/validated scan reconstruction→DFAM, material/process choice.
  • Geometry export, units/watertight/features check; orientation/supports, slicing.
  • Machine-compatible instructions generate/review; approved proceduresથી operation.
  • Remove/clean/support-release, required cure/heat treatment/machining/post-process.
  • Required dimensions, surface, internal integrity/performance inspect; evidenceથી update.

h.en: 5.2.2 STL file format: concept and limits

body.en:
Definition / principle

STL approximates a boundary surface by triangular facets; it is not the toolpath or a complete manufacturing specification.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Facets contain vertices and orientation/normal information; binary and ASCII encodings exist.
  • Tessellation tolerance affects faceting, error and file size; fine triangles cannot repair an incorrect CAD design.
  • Common STL does not reliably encode engineering units, material, colour or exact analytic curves; units must be managed explicitly.
  • Check manifold/watertight boundary, holes, reversed normals, self-intersection and scale before slicing; an exported file can still be unprintable.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

STL triangular facetsથી boundary approximate કરે; toolpath/complete manufacturing spec નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Facets vertices, orientation/normal; binary/ASCII encodings.
  • Tolerance faceting, error, size બદલે; fine triangles wrong CAD repair નહિ કરે.
  • Common STL engineering units, material, colour, exact curves reliably encode નહિ; units explicit રાખો.
  • Manifold/watertight, holes, normals, self-intersection, scale check; exported file પણ unprintable હોઈ શકે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Feedstock form, process and final performance must match; not every polymer or metal runs in every printer.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Thermoplastic filaments/pellets: FDM-compatible grades such as PLA, ABS and other approved polymers; temperature and moisture behaviour differ.
  • Photopolymer resins: SLA-compatible chemistry; cured properties differ from thermoplastic filament and require approved post-cure.
  • Powders: polymer/metal/ceramic feedstocks for compatible routes; particle size, flow, packing, reuse and contamination matter.
  • Wires: WAAM-compatible metal wire must suit welding metallurgy, gas, substrate and qualification.
  • Choose strength, temperature, chemical exposure, accuracy, finish, cost and applicable certification; build orientation and post-process can change properties.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Feed form, process, performance match;દરેક polymer/metal દરેક printerમાં નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Thermoplastic filament/pellets PLA, ABS/approved polymers; temperature, moisture જુદાં.
  • Photopolymer resins SLA-compatible; cured properties filamentથી જુદી, approved post-cure જોઈએ.
  • Compatible powders polymer/metal/ceramic; size, flow, packing, reuse, contamination મહત્વનાં.
  • WAAM wire metallurgy, gas, substrate, qualification મુજબ.
  • Strength, temp, chemical, accuracy, finish, cost, certification; orientation/post-process properties બદલે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Heated thermoplastic feedstock is extruded in controlled tracks that bond into successive layers.

Classification / representative type

  • Family: material extrusion; filament-fed and pellet-fed variants exist. The common teaching example is filament-fed FDM.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Feed spool and drive gears meter compatible filament.
  2. Hot end/heater and nozzle soften and extrude material.
  3. Motion axes position nozzle and build platform along planned paths.
  4. Build surface/platform supports initial layer; heating/enclosure depend on material and machine.
  5. Controller executes sliced instructions including extrusion, travel and layer changes.
  6. Cooling, guards, ventilation and sensing support temperature control and safe operation.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Validated geometry is oriented and sliced with suitable supports and material settings.
  2. Drive feeds filament to the heated zone.
  3. Nozzle deposits roads onto the build surface/previous layer.
  4. Adjacent roads and layers bond while cooling; bond quality depends on thermal history.
  5. Layer increment repeats the planned cross-sections until the shape is complete.
  6. Approved removal/support finishing and inspection assess dimensions, bonding and defects.

Working parameters / controls

  • Nozzle/material temperature, layer height, road width, speed and cooling affect bonding, surface and time.
  • Orientation, infill, shells, supports and moisture affect stiffness, anisotropy, warping and porosity; no universal values are prescribed.

Applications / advantages

Prototypes, custom jigs and suitable functional polymer parts; accessible tooling and material choices.

Limitations / safety

Layer anisotropy, stair steps, warping, thermal/fume hazards and support marks; printed strength must be qualified for the load.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Heated thermoplastic tracksમાં extrude થઈ successive layersમાં bond થાય.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Family material extrusion; filament/pellet variants;અહીં common filament-fed.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Feed spool અને drive gears compatible filamentને માપેલી માત્રામાં આગળ ધપાવે છે,જેથી extrusion માટે સતત feed મળે.
  2. Hot end/heater filamentને soften કરે છે અને nozzle તેને નિયંત્રિત આકારમાં બહાર કાઢે છે.
  3. Motion axes nozzle તથા build platformને planned paths મુજબ relative position આપે છે.
  4. Build surface/platform શરૂઆતના layerને આધાર આપે છે. Heating અથવા enclosureની જરૂર material અને machine પર આધારિત છે.
  5. Controller sliced instructions મુજબ extrusion,travel અને layer changesનો ક્રમ ચલાવે છે.
  6. Cooling,guards,ventilation તથા sensing temperature control અને safe operationમાં મદદ કરે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Validated geometry માટે orientation,supports અને material settings નક્કી કરીને slicing થાય છે,જેથી layersના paths મળે.
  2. Drive filamentને heated zoneમાં પહોંચાડે છે,જ્યાં તે extrusion માટે જરૂરી soft સ્થિતિમાં આવે છે.
  3. Nozzle build surface અથવા previous layer ઉપર materialની roads મૂકે છે;આ solid blockને કાપવાની પ્રક્રિયા નથી.
  4. પાસપાસની roads તથા layers cooling દરમિયાન bond થાય છે. Bondની quality thermal history પર આધારિત રહે છે.
  5. દરેક layer પછી height increment થાય છે અને planned cross-sections પુનરાવર્તિત થઈ સંપૂર્ણ shape બને છે.
  6. મંજૂર removal તથા support finishing પછી dimensions,bonding અને defects તપાસાય છે;ફક્ત print complete થવું પૂરતું નથી.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Temperature, layer height, road width, speed, cooling bonding/surface/time બદલે.
  • Orientation, infill, shells, supports, moisture stiffness, anisotropy, warp, porosity બદલે; universal values નહિ.

Applications / લાભ

Prototypes, custom jigs, suitable functional polymer parts; accessible tooling/materials.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Anisotropy, steps, warping, thermal/fume hazards, support marks; load માટે strength qualify.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Light selectively cures a photopolymer resin layer into solid material.

Classification / representative type

  • Family: vat photopolymerisation; laser-scanned SLA differs from projected-image DLP though both use photosensitive resin.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Resin vat contains process-compatible liquid photopolymer.
  2. Build platform and Z motion position the part relative to the curing region.
  3. Light source and scan optics selectively expose the layer in laser SLA.
  4. Recoating/separation arrangement supplies a fresh controlled resin layer according to top-/bottom-up design.
  5. Controller uses sliced cross-sections and support geometry.
  6. Protected enclosure, approved wash/post-cure facilities and PPE/waste controls manage resin/light hazards.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Validated geometry is oriented, supported and sliced.
  2. A controlled layer of resin occupies the exposure region.
  3. Light initiates polymerisation in selected areas.
  4. Platform/separation motion permits a new layer without damaging the partially formed part.
  5. Repeated exposure bonds layers into the intended shape.
  6. Approved washing, support removal and post-curing precede dimensional/property inspection.

Working parameters / controls

  • Exposure dose, layer thickness, scan pattern, resin state, orientation and separation forces affect cure and distortion.
  • Post-cure and ageing affect final properties; resin appearance alone does not establish cure or biocompatibility.

Applications / advantages

Fine-feature prototypes, patterns and qualified resin parts needing good surface detail.

Limitations / safety

Resin skin/eye hazards, uncured residue, limited material behaviour, supports and UV/light hazards; no home chemical-handling recipe.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Light photopolymer resinને selectively cure કરી solid layer બનાવે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Family vat photopolymerisation; laser SLA, projected DLPથી જુદું, both resin.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Resin vatમાં process-compatible liquid photopolymer રહે છે;સામાન્ય thermoplastic filament અહીંનો feedstock નથી.
  2. Build platform અને Z motion curing region સામે partનું સ્થાન નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
  3. Laser SLAમાં light source અને scan optics layerના પસંદ કરેલા વિસ્તારોને expose કરે છે.
  4. Top-/bottom-up design મુજબ recoating/separation arrangement નવા controlled resin layer માટે જગ્યા અને resin આપે છે.
  5. Controller sliced cross-sections અને support geometry મુજબ exposure તથા motionનો ક્રમ સંભાળે છે.
  6. Protected enclosure,approved wash/post-cure facilities તથા PPE/waste controls resin અને lightના hazards સંભાળે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Validated geometryને orient કરી યોગ્ય supports આપ્યા પછી slices બનાવાય છે.
  2. Exposure regionમાં controlled resin layer આવે છે,જેથી ઇચ્છિત thicknessના materialને cure કરી શકાય.
  3. Light પસંદ કરેલા વિસ્તારોમાં polymerisation શરૂ કરે છે અને liquid resinનો તે ભાગ solid બને છે.
  4. Platform/separation motion partially formed partને નુકસાન કર્યા વગર આગળના layer માટે જગ્યા બનાવે છે.
  5. Repeated exposureથી નવા layers અગાઉના layers સાથે bond થઈ ઇચ્છિત shape બનાવે છે.
  6. મંજૂર washing,support removal અને post-curing પૂર્ણ થયા પછી dimensions તથા propertiesની તપાસ થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Dose, layer thickness, scan, resin, orientation, separation forces cure/distortion બદલે.
  • Post-cure, ageing properties બદલે; appearanceથી cure/biocompatibility prove નહિ.

Applications / લાભ

Fine-feature prototypes, patterns, qualified resin parts.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Resin hazards, residue, material limits, supports, light hazards; home recipe નહિ.

h.en: 5.4.1 SLS naming: read the syllabus without mixing materials

body.en:
Definition / principle

The source places Selective Laser Sintering under Metal AM; that label needs context rather than silently teaching a nylon printer as a metal process.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • SLS commonly names polymer powder-bed laser sintering; metal routes are often described as metal laser powder-bed fusion, DMLS/SLM or legacy metal laser-sintering terminology.
  • Powder-bed laser principle is shared, but material, thermal behaviour, atmosphere, supports and post-processing differ.
  • Direct metal laser routes may melt powder; indirect/binder-assisted routes can need debinding, sintering/infiltration. The word sintering alone does not prove every metal particle remained solid.
  • Answer5.4with the stated metal context and explain the actual mechanism; do not claim ordinary polymer SLS makes dense metal parts.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Source SLSને Metal AMમાં મૂકે છે; context જોઈએ, nylon printerને metal process ન શીખવો.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • SLS સામાન્ય polymer laser sintering; metalમાં laser powder-bed fusion, DMLS/SLM/legacy metal-sintering terminology.
  • Principle shared,પણ material, thermal behaviour, atmosphere, supports, post-process જુદાં.
  • Direct metalમાં powder melt થઈ શકે; indirect/binderમાં debind, sinter/infiltrate;સિન્ટરિંગ શબ્દથી દરેક particle solid રહ્યો prove નહિ.
  • 5.4માં metal context, actual mechanism લખો; ordinary polymer SLS dense metal part બનાવે એવો દાવો નહિ.

h.en: 5.4.2 Metal laser powder-bed route (source metal SLS context)
h.gu: 5.4.2 Metal Laser Powder-bed Route (Source Metal SLS Context)

body.en:
Definition / principle

A laser selectively bonds/fuses compatible powder cross-sections; the actual metal route must state direct fusion or indirect post-sintering requirements.

Classification / representative type

  • Family: powder-bed fusion for the representative direct laser metal route; polymer SLS and indirect metal routes are not identical specifications.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Compatible metal powder supply and build chamber contain feedstock.
  2. Recoater spreads a controlled powder layer across the build area.
  3. Laser, scan optics and focus control deliver local energy.
  4. Build plate/platform and Z movement establish successive layers.
  5. Controlled atmosphere, filtration and thermal management limit oxidation and transport emissions as designed.
  6. Support structures where required, monitoring, contained powder handling and post-process facilities support the qualified route.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Validated geometry is oriented and sliced with process-appropriate supports/allowances.
  2. A thin powder layer is spread with controlled uniformity.
  3. Laser scans selected cross-section and bonds/fuses material by the actual approved route.
  4. Platform changes height and recoating supplies the next layer.
  5. Layers accumulate; thermal history and scan strategy influence stress, porosity and distortion.
  6. Contained powder removal and required stress relief/support removal/finishing/inspection complete the part—not the build alone.

Working parameters / controls

  • Laser energy/scan speed, hatch spacing, layer thickness, powder quality, atmosphere and preheat affect density and geometry.
  • Energy density is only a simplified descriptor; equal nominal values do not guarantee equal melt stability or properties.

Applications / advantages

Complex qualified metal parts, conformal-channel tooling and weight-optimised designs.

Limitations / safety

Cost, powder/fire/inhalation hazards, residual stress, supports, build size and qualification; no powder handling or laser operating procedure is given.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Laser compatible powder sections bond/fuse કરે; direct fusion/indirect post-sintering requirements સ્પષ્ટ રાખો.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Representative direct laser metal family powder-bed fusion; polymer SLS, indirect metal same specifications નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Compatible metal powder supply તથા build chamber feedstockને નિયંત્રિત વિસ્તારમાં રાખે છે;polymer powderને metal feed ન માનવો.
  2. Recoater build areaમાં નિયંત્રિત powder layer ફેલાવે છે,જેથી laserને સમાન પ્રકારનો layer મળે.
  3. Laser,scan optics અને focus control પસંદ કરેલા નાના વિસ્તારમાં જરૂરી energy પહોંચાડે છે.
  4. Build plate/platform તથા Z movement successive layersની ઊંચાઈ અને આધાર નક્કી કરે છે.
  5. Controlled atmosphere,filtration અને thermal management design મુજબ oxidation તથા emissions નિયંત્રિત કરે છે.
  6. જરૂરી support structures,monitoring,contained powder handling અને post-process facilities સંપૂર્ણ qualified routeને આધાર આપે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Validated geometryને actual process માટે યોગ્ય supports અને allowances સાથે orient તથા slice કરવામાં આવે છે.
  2. નિયંત્રિત uniformity ધરાવતો thin powder layer build areaમાં ફેલાવવામાં આવે છે.
  3. Laser selected cross-section scan કરે છે અને actual approved route મુજબ powderને bond/fuse કરે છે;mechanism સ્પષ્ટ રાખવું જરૂરી છે.
  4. Platformની height બદલાય છે અને recoating આગળના layer માટે powder આપે છે.
  5. Layers એકત્ર થતાં shape બને છે. Thermal history તથા scan strategy residual stress,porosity અને distortionને અસર કરે છે.
  6. Contained powder removal અને જરૂરી stress relief,support removal,finishing તથા inspectionથી part પૂર્ણ થાય છે;ફક્ત buildથી નહિ.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Energy/speed, hatch, layer, powder, atmosphere, preheat density/geometry બદલે.
  • Energy density simplified descriptor; same valueથી same stability/properties guarantee નહિ.

Applications / લાભ

Complex qualified metal parts, conformal-channel tooling, weight-optimised designs.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Cost, powder/fire/inhalation hazards, stress, supports, size, qualification; handling/laser procedure નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

An electric arc melts supplied metal wire to deposit beads that build a near-net component.

Classification / representative type

  • Family: wire/arc directed energy deposition; arc variants follow suitable GMAW/GTAW/plasma-based arrangements rather than one universal torch.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Compatible metal wire spool/feeder supplies deposition material.
  2. Arc power source and torch provide controlled melting.
  3. Robot/gantry manipulates torch and/or substrate along planned paths.
  4. Substrate/build fixture resists thermal loads and provides initial support.
  5. Shielding and interpass thermal management limit oxidation and overheating.
  6. Monitoring, enclosure/extraction and finishing/inspection facilities complete the cell.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. Geometry is converted to suitable bead/layer paths with allowance for finishing.
  2. Wire reaches the arc zone and melts.
  3. Molten metal forms a bead on the substrate/previous layer.
  4. Controlled travel and wire delivery establish bead size/overlap.
  5. Layer changes and interpass thermal control accumulate shape without uncontrolled heat build-up.
  6. Cooling, required heat treatment/machining and inspection establish final properties/dimensions.

Working parameters / controls

  • Current/voltage, wire feed, travel speed, bead overlap, layer height, gas and interpass temperature affect geometry/metallurgy.
  • Robot path, heat input and restraint affect residual stress/distortion; settings require qualification, not classroom guesswork.

Applications / advantages

Large near-net metal structures/repair/build-up where deposition productivity and machining allowance suit the part.

Limitations / safety

Coarser beads/surface, thermal distortion, metallurgical defects, welding radiation/fumes and subsequent machining; not a finished-precision surface by default.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Electric arc wire melt કરી beads deposit કરે, near-net component બનાવે.

Classification / Representative Type

  • Family wire/arc DED; GMAW/GTAW/plasma-based variants,એક universal torch નહિ.

Construction — ભાગ અને કામ

  1. Compatible metal wire spool/feeder deposition માટે જરૂરી wireને નિયંત્રિત રીતે પહોંચાડે છે.
  2. Arc power source અને torch wireને નિયંત્રિત રીતે melt કરવા energy આપે છે.
  3. Robot/gantry planned paths મુજબ torch અને/અથવા substrateનું relative motion ચલાવે છે.
  4. Substrate/build fixture શરૂઆતનો આધાર આપે છે અને processના thermal loads સહન કરે છે.
  5. Shielding તથા interpass thermal management oxidation અને overheating ઘટાડવામાં મદદ કરે છે.
  6. Monitoring,enclosure/extraction તથા finishing/inspection facilities મળીને સંપૂર્ણ cell બનાવે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Geometryને suitable bead/layer pathsમાં ફેરવાય છે અને પછીની finishing માટે જરૂરી allowance રાખવામાં આવે છે.
  2. Wire arcના વિસ્તારમાં પહોંચે છે અને arcની ગરમીથી પીગળે છે.
  3. Molten metal substrate અથવા previous layer પર bead તરીકે જમા થાય છે.
  4. Controlled travel તથા wire delivery beadનું size અને overlap નક્કી કરે છે.
  5. Layer changes તથા interpass thermal controlથી uncontrolled heat build-up ઘટાડીને shape એકત્ર કરવામાં આવે છે.
  6. Cooling પછી જરૂરી heat treatment,machining અને inspection દ્વારા final properties તથા dimensions સ્થાપિત થાય છે.

Working Parameters / Controls

  • Current/voltage, wire feed, travel, overlap, height, gas, interpass geometry/metallurgy બદલે.
  • Path, heat input, restraint stress/distortion બદલે; qualified settings જોઈએ.

Applications / લાભ

Suitable large near-net structures/repair/build-up.

મર્યાદાઓ / Safety

Coarse beads/surface, distortion, defects, radiation/fumes, machining; default precision finish નહિ.

h.en: 5.4.4 Selecting FDM, SLA, powder-bed or WAAM

body.en:
Definition / principle

Start with part requirements, material and inspection responsibility before choosing a familiar machine.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Low-cost polymer fit prototype: FDM may suit; fine resin detail/pattern: SLA may suit, subject to resin properties.
  • Complex qualified metal channels: metal powder-bed route may suit; large near-net metal form: WAAM may suit if finishing/heat control are acceptable.
  • Compare required accuracy, load/environment, build size, orientation, supports, post-processing, lead time, total cost and safety.
  • Neither an STL nor nominal material datasheet proves a printed part is structurally or medically qualified.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Part requirements, material, inspection responsibilityથી શરૂઆત.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Low-cost polymer fit prototype FDM; fine resin detail/pattern SLA, properties મુજબ.
  • Complex metal channels powder-bed; large near-net form WAAM જો finishing/heat control acceptable.
  • Accuracy, load/environment, size, orientation, supports, post-process, time, total cost, safety compare.
  • STL/nominal datasheetથી printed part structural/medical qualification prove નહિ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Industry4.0 is connected, data-driven production in which physical equipment and digital systems exchange information for coordinated monitoring and decisions.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Cyber-physical integration links measured physical state with computational models, control and people; it is more than installing a computer beside a machine.
  • Example: machine condition and quality records inform maintenance and scheduling through validated data links; local safeguards remain responsible for safe machine behaviour.
  • Choose technologies for a defined quality, delivery, flexibility or resource-use problem; measure benefit, security and reliability rather than treating connectivity as an end in itself.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Industry4.0માં physical equipment અને digital systems data exchange કરે છે,જેથી productionનું monitoring તથા decisions coordinated અને data-driven બને છે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Cyber-physical integration measured physical stateને models, control અને લોકો સાથે જોડે છે; machine પાસે computer મુકવો એટલું જ નહિ.
  • Exampleમાં machine condition તથા quality recordsના validated links maintenance/schedulingને માહિતી આપે છે; safe machine behaviour માટે local safeguards રહે છે.
  • Quality, delivery, flexibility અથવા resource-use problem માટે technology પસંદ કરો; benefit, security, reliability માપો,ફક્ત connectivityને goal ન માનો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The stages describe broad changes in production capability, not exact universal transition dates for every factory.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • First: mechanisation with water/steam power.
  • Second: electrical power, mass production and division of labour.
  • Third: electronics, computers and programmable automation.
  • Fourth: connected cyber-physical systems, data-driven coordination and intelligent manufacturing; older/newer systems often coexist.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Stages broad production changes છે,દરેક factoryની exact dates નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • First water/steamથી mechanisation.
  • Second electrical power, mass production, labour division.
  • Third electronics, computers, programmable automation.
  • Fourth connected cyber-physical, data-driven coordination, intelligent manufacturing;જૂનું-નવું coexist કરે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A commonly taught nine-pillar framework groups enabling technologies; it is not a claim that every factory must buy all nine immediately.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Big data/analytics: find patterns in process/quality records; autonomous robots: adaptable automated handling/processing.
  • Simulation: test plans virtually; horizontal/vertical integration: link suppliers, production functions and business levels.
  • Industrial IoT: connected sensing/devices; cybersecurity: protect data, access and operational continuity.
  • Cloud: scalable computing/data services; additive manufacturing: digital material addition; augmented reality: contextual digital information over a real task.
  • AI is introduced separately in this syllabus and can support several pillars; do not silently replace one of the named nine with AI.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Common nine-pillar framework enabling technologies group કરે;દરેક factoryએ તરત બધી ખરીદવી જરૂરી નહિ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Big data/analytics process/quality patterns; autonomous robots adaptable handling/processing.
  • Simulation virtual tests; horizontal/vertical integration suppliers, functions, business levels જોડે.
  • Industrial IoT connected sensing/devices; cybersecurity data, access, continuity protect.
  • Cloud scalable compute/data; AM digital material addition; AR real task પર contextual digital info.
  • AI syllabusમાં અલગ intro,અનેક pillars support કરે; named nineમાં કોઈને silently replace નહિ.

h.en: 5.5.4 IoT in manufacturing: signal and decision chain

body.en:
Definition / principle

Industrial IoT connects physical measurements and machine status to meaningful monitoring and decisions.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Smart sensor measures a quantity and may condition/digitise it; calibration, units, sampling and uncertainty still matter.
  • Connectivity/gateway transfers identified, time-stamped data using suitable protocols; networking alone does not create useful information.
  • Data platform/dashboard contextualises machine, job and operating mode; real-time means meeting the application latency, not zero delay.
  • Example: vibration/temperature trends flag abnormal machine behaviour; maintenance decisions need validated limits and investigation.
  • Access control, segmentation, updates, data quality and safe response to lost connectivity protect production; remote data must not bypass local safeguards.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Industrial IoT physical measurements, machine statusને monitoring, decisions સાથે જોડે.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Smart sensor quantity measure, condition/digitise કરી શકે; calibration, units, sampling, uncertainty જરૂરી.
  • Connectivity/gateway identified, time-stamped data આપે;ફક્ત networking useful info નહિ.
  • Platform/dashboard machine, job, mode context આપે; real-time required latency, zero delay નહિ.
  • Vibration/temp trends abnormal behaviour બતાવે; decisions માટે validated limits, investigation.
  • Access, segmentation, updates, data quality, connectivity-loss response production protect; remote data local safeguards bypass નહિ.

h.en: 5.5.5 Digital twin versus physical system and digital model
h.gu: 5.5.5 Digital Twin સામે Physical System, Digital Model

body.en:
Definition / principle

A digital twin is a purpose-specific digital representation linked to physical-system data and maintained for its intended decisions.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Physical system is the actual machine/line/part with real loads, wear and uncertainty.
  • A standalone CAD/simulation model can exist without ongoing physical data; not every3Dmodel is a twin.
  • Twin combines model, data links, state updates and validation; automatic bidirectional control is optional and must be specifically engineered.
  • Applications: virtual commissioning, maintenance diagnosis, capacity experiments, process optimisation and traceability where supported by reliable data.
  • Limitations: model mismatch, sensor errors, latency, cost and cybersecurity; always compare predictions with evidence for the intended use.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Digital twin physical-system data સાથે linked, purpose-specific maintained digital representation.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Physical system actual machine/line/part, real loads, wear, uncertainty.
  • Standalone CAD/simulation ongoing data વગર;દરેક3Dmodel twin નહિ.
  • Twin model, data links, state updates, validation જોડે; automatic bidirectional control optional, engineered.
  • Applications virtual commissioning, diagnosis, capacity experiments, optimisation, traceability.
  • Limits model mismatch, sensor error, latency, cost, cybersecurity; predictions evidence સાથે compare.

h.en: 5.5.6 AI: defect detection, predictive maintenance, optimisation

body.en:
Definition / principle

AI models learn/use patterns to assist manufacturing decisions; performance must be validated for the actual operating domain.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Defect detection: images/sensor data classify anomalies; false accepts/false rejects, label quality, lighting and product changes affect reliability.
  • Predictive maintenance: condition trends estimate failure risk or remaining service; it differs from merely alarming on a current high temperature.
  • Process optimisation: models suggest settings/schedules within material, machine, quality and safety constraints; objective functions can conflict.
  • Workflow: data collection→clean/label→train/validate→deploy with monitoring→review drift and retrain as justified.
  • Human oversight, traceability and safe fallback remain essential; AI is not proof of zero defects or permission to override interlocks.
Is every standalone3Dmodel a digital twin?

No. A twin needs purpose-specific linkage to physical data, state updates and validation; automatic closed-loop control is not assumed.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

AI patternsથી decisions assist કરે; actual domainમાં validation જોઈએ.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Defect detection images/sensorsથી; false accept/reject, labels, lighting, product changes reliability બદલે.
  • Predictive maintenance trendsથી failure risk/remaining service; current high-temp alarmથી જુદું.
  • Optimisation constraintsમાં settings/schedules suggest કરે; objectives conflict થઈ શકે.
  • Workflow data→clean/label→train/validate→monitored deploy→drift/retrain.
  • Human oversight, traceability, safe fallback જરૂરી; AI zero-defects proof/interlock override permission નહિ.
દરેક Standalone3Dmodel Digital Twin છે?

ના.Twin માટે purpose-specific physical data linkage, state updates, validation જોઈએ; automatic closed-loop control માની લેવાતું નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Plan a simple approved AM job and record only genuine execution/inspection evidence. No printed product is claimed by these notes.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Define application, dimensions, fit/load/environment and acceptance needs; select suitable process/material with reasons.
  • Create CAD using software or validated3Dscanner reconstruction; check scale, missing surfaces and geometry before export.
  • Export/check STL or supported format; verify units, watertightness, orientation and tessellation rather than assuming the file is valid.
  • In slicer choose supported machine/material profile, orientation, layer plan, infill/shells and supports; preview paths and predicted time/material.
  • State why material suits the application; compare required performance with orientation, moisture, thermal history and post-processing limits.
  • Produce only through supervised approved printer procedures, ventilation and safe hot/moving-part controls; record actual machine/profile, job status and deviations.
  • After approved removal/finishing, inspect actual dimensions, surface, bonding and defects; compare prediction with observation without inventing print time or strength.
  • Report CAD/version, export/slicer settings basis, material justification, actual build evidence, inspection and limitations; if not executed, mark planned—not completed.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Simple approved AM job plan કરો;ફક્ત actual execution/inspection evidence લખો.આ notes કોઈ product print થયાનો દાવો કરતી નથી.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Application, dimensions, fit/load/environment, acceptance નક્કી; reasoned process/material select.
  • Software CAD/validated3Dscanner reconstruction; export પહેલાં scale, missing surfaces, geometry check.
  • Export પછી units, watertightness, orientation, tessellation verify; file automatically valid નહિ.
  • Slicerમાં supported machine/material profile, orientation, layers, infill/shells, supports; paths, predicted time/material preview.
  • Material કેમ યોગ્ય સમજાવો; orientation, moisture, thermal history, post-process limits સાથે performance compare.
  • Approved supervised procedures, ventilation, hot/moving-part safetyથી produce; actual machine/profile, status, deviations record.
  • Approved removal/finish પછી dimensions, surface, bonding, defects inspect; predicted/observed compare, time/strength invent નહિ.
  • CAD/version, export/slicer basis, material reason, build evidence, inspection, limitations report; execute ન થયું હોય તો planned લખો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The source suggests group activity reports of about5pages; attach only genuine work/source evidence.

Understand the syllabus demand

  • Design a simple CAD model and use supervised3Dprinting when available; otherwise mark the exercise planned.
  • Prepare an Industry4.0/smart-manufacturing chart/model showing the data and decision chain.
  • Compare conventional and additive manufacture for the same defined part and requirements.
  • Prepare a sourced report/presentation on current WAAM/metal-AM trends; date sources and distinguish commercial claims from measured results.

Definition / Principle

Source group reports આશરે5pages સૂચવે છે;ફક્ત genuine work/source evidence જોડો.

Syllabusની માંગ સમજીએ

  • Simple CAD model, supported supervised3Dprinting કરો;ઉપલબ્ધ ન હોય તો planned લખો.
  • Industry4.0/smart-manufacturing chart/modelમાં data/decision chain બતાવો.
  • Same defined part/requirements માટે conventional, AM compare કરો.
  • WAAM/metal-AM trends પર sourced report/presentation; source dates, claims/measured results અલગ રાખો.
